name: Pokedex Sprites (HGSS)
description: Replaces the Pokedex ENTRY PAGE art with HeartGold/SoulSilver-style sprites for all 151 species, and repaints the dex list's caught marker as a red-and-white Poke Ball. NOTE: engine v0.2.13 gates full-colour art behind the COLORS mode -- Gen 1 needs COLORS set to ADVANCED or the art renders in flat shades. DEX COLOR option picks how the art is marked for true colour (BANDS is the robust default; EXACT/BOX/OFF are there for comparison). Fan-art sprite swap sourced from Bulbagarden Archives; personal use.
